scope: Floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing, and extraction/STA/signoff research (D04/D05).

compute.status: Coordinator-selected provisional pilot caps, not user-provided resource commitments
compute.agent_usage: Existing ChatGPT/Codex entitlement only for all three roles. No Claude or DeepSeek calls, paid API fallback, top-ups or new compute purchases. Native quota failures are recorded and retried after backoff.

deepseek_api_allowance.limit: The existing prepaid DeepSeek API balance only; no top-ups or new purchases.
deepseek_api_allowance.procedure: Before each challenger launch the DeepSeek lead records the observed balance in that launch's run record. Work stops when the balance is exhausted; there are no automatic retries.
deepseek_api_allowance.relation_to_api_budget_usd: api_budget_usd 0 means no new money. Spending this already-prepaid balance is the only paid-API exception.

No claim of silicon signoff, multi-corner coverage, or commercial-tool parity from this pilot.
engineering_user: Physical-design and timing-closure engineer; practitioner validation remains pending.

primary_metric.status: Provisional research screening contract; each topic must preregister its own endpoint before experiments
primary_metric.D04: Post-route extracted maximum setup slack (ns) at fixed SDC, cell library and die area; report TNS, hold, area, power estimate and flow failures as guardrails.
primary_metric.D05: Wall time to obtain the same timing decisions as pinned full OpenSTA analysis; report maximum endpoint slack error and false-negative violating endpoints.
primary_metric.floorplan: Post-route outcomes required; macro-rich designs still missing, so macro-floorplanning feasibility remains conditional.

minimum_meaningful_effect.status: Provisional thresholds, not measured gains or proven engineer requirements
minimum_meaningful_effect.D04: At least +0.02 ns paired improvement in worst setup slack with no new hold violations, no added route DRC, <=2% cell-area and estimated-power regression, <=20% runtime regression.
minimum_meaningful_effect.D05: At least 20% wall-time reduction; maximum absolute endpoint slack error <=0.005 ns and zero missed violating endpoints against the reference on evaluated cases.
minimum_meaningful_effect.evidence: Require >=3 independently selected designs and >=5 paired seeds per stochastic condition, confidence intervals and all failures. GCD alone cannot establish success. Revise thresholds after baseline variance and practitioner input, before candidate evaluation.

feasibility_status: Infrastructure smoke verified; topic-level R1 feasibility remains conditional on representative designs, baseline reproduction, domain oracle and role review.
review_policy: Owner-authorized bounded batch: D04 and D05 run concurrently; each domain stops after four completed proposer/challenger/verifier cycles, including any successor candidates. Report unresolved evidence honestly.

innovation_policy.preference: Seek high-quality combination contributions and, where supported, structural innovations for chip EDA.
eligible_routes: Agentic EDA and cooperating algorithmic agents
Traditional EDA and cross-stage system contributions
innovation_policy.assessment: Test the claimed useful system-level delta against strong applicable prior systems and straightforward composition; do not reject known components by category.
innovation_policy.combination_drift: Unsupported degradation of the frozen contribution, not a penalty for using combinations.
innovation_policy.precision_contract: Distinguish approximate prediction, probabilistic guarantees and scoped engine-relative exactness.
innovation_policy.execution_effect: Direction clarification only; no restart of the completed bounded batch, new resource allocation or change to historical frozen decisions.
